|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “During your control phase, move any one of your characters to a Dagobah site. OR During your deploy phase, ▼ character, starship, vehicle, weapon, or device to a Dagobah site (regardless of Dagobah deployment restrictions).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[You Will Go To The Dagobah System (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy a character, device, starship, vehicle, or weapon to a Dagobah site (regardless of Dagobah deployment restrictions) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During your control phase, relocate your character to a Dagobah site.” '''What changed:''' “During your control phase, move any one of your characters to” → “Deploy”; removed “Dagobah site. OR During your deploy phase, ▼”; added “device,”; removed “weapon,”; “device” → “weapon”; “restrictions).” → “restrictions) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During your control phase, relocate your character to a Dagobah site.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 25*. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System]].
* Later text: [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System]].
